Subject: Intro: Senior ML Infrastructure candidate — Maya S.

Hi Jordan / team,

Hope you're well — Aperture Talent has an outgoing candidate I wanted to surface for your Senior ML Infrastructure role. Short summary:
- Name: Maya Shah
- Current: Staff ML Engineer (inference infra) at NovaScale (distributed model serving stack)
- Experience: 8+ years backend + ML infra, shipping KV cache and batching improvements, led quantization rollout on multi-tenant infra
- Why a fit: strong low-level infra + MLOps experience, production performance focus similar to Redwood's priorities

Attached is her resume and a short take-home she can complete if you want a quick skills signal. Candidate is interview-available next week mornings PST (Mon/Tue/Wed).

Would you be open to a 40-min technical screen first, then a systems design loop if that goes well? If so, tell me 2 slots that work and I will align with her calendar.

Attachments: MayaShah_Resume.pdf, MayaShah_Takehome-Instructions.pdf

Best,

Subject: Re: Intro: Senior ML Infrastructure candidate — Maya S.

Quick debrief from today's 40-min screen:

Summary:
- Strengths: deep familiarity with KV cache eviction strategies, thoughtful about latency vs. memory trade-offs, clear ownership examples of rolling quantization changes in production.
- Signals of concern: limited exposure to cluster autoscaling policies for heterogeneous GPU fleets (no direct ownership), and her design on sharding for KV cache lacked a failure-recovery path in the sketch.

Scorecard (rough):
- System design: 7/10
- Debugging/problem solving: 8/10
- Production impact & leadership: 8/10
- Cultural fit: 8/10

Next steps suggestion: ask Aperture for a short follow-up conversation focused on autoscaling/ops experience (20–30 min) and request code pointers or PRs if available. If Aperture can get that and the take-home looks clean, I recommend we move to on-site loop.

Rebecca — can you coordinate that follow-up and ask for PR links or code samples? Marissa, happy for you to own scheduling the loop if we greenlight it.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
